question: How many paid leave days can I still take this year?

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT EXTRACT

Employee ID: EMP-1042
Work location: Belgium
Employment type: Full-time
Department: Engineering
Contract version: 2.0
Effective date: 3 January 2026
Document owner: People Operations
Status: Active

The employee is entitled to the statutory paid leave provided by the active Belgian leave policy. In addition to that statutory entitlement, the employee receives 2 company leave days during each complete calendar year.

Company leave days are tracked separately but may be booked through the same time-management workflow. Unused company leave expires at the end of the calendar year and cannot be converted into salary unless required by applicable law.

This contractual benefit supplements the country policy; it does not replace or reduce the employee's statutory entitlement.

content.full_text:
BELGIUM PAID LEAVE POLICY — 2026

Document owner: HR Legal Belgium
Version: 3.2
Effective from: 1 January 2026
Effective until: 31 December 2026
Status: Active

Full-time employees working in Belgium receive 20 statutory paid leave days for the 2026 calendar year. Part-time entitlement is calculated proportionally according to the employee's contractual working schedule.

Additional company leave granted in an individual employment contract is tracked separately and is added to the statutory entitlement. Approved leave, leave already taken, and pending bookings must all be considered when calculating the number of days still available.

Employees should submit planned leave through the time-management system. A booking only becomes final after manager approval. When this policy conflicts with an older FAQ or informal HR message, this active policy takes precedence unless an employee contract provides an additional individual benefit.

Questions that cannot be answered from the current policy, employee contract, and live leave balance should be escalated to HR Operations.

HR LEAVE FAQ — ARCHIVED 2024 EDITION

Document owner: HR Support
Version: 1.0
Effective from: 1 January 2024
Effective until: 31 December 2024
Status: Expired — retained for historical reference

How many paid leave days does a full-time employee in Belgium receive?

Under the policy used for this archived FAQ, a full-time Belgian employee receives 18 paid leave days per calendar year. Extra contractual leave may apply in exceptional cases and employees should contact HR for confirmation.

How can leave be requested?

Employees request leave through the time-management portal. Requests remain provisional until approved by the employee's manager.

Important: this FAQ has expired and must not be used as the primary source for 2026 entitlement calculations. Consult the current country policy and the employee's contract instead.
